title: AEON Pilot 01 · Vacío temporal × persistencia de respuesta · Invisibilidad Relacional
purpose: Calibrate whether deterministic changes in temporal information density produce repeatable changes in a predeclared subjective outcome before testing wound-specific carrier correspondences.

source_basis.claim: Vacío is defined as low-information structure used to modulate expectation; measurement remains an open question.
Cristalización is defined as prolonged stabilization of an interpretation; measurement remains an open question.
Invisibilidad Relacional includes difficulty occupying space and disconnection from one's own presence.
Retención Afectiva is a named symbolic crystallization; 432 Hz and alpha 8–10 Hz are documented method signal options in relevant dimensions.

primary_question: Within the same participant, does changing only temporal silence ratio alter felt_presence ratings in a repeatable direction while carrier/modulation, cycle length and predictability are held constant?
null_interpretation: If felt_presence changes are smaller than the pilot threshold, inconsistent in direction across replicated sessions, or equally explained by order/recovery effects, the pilot does not support treating temporal Void as a meaningful driver for this outcome.

crystallization_test.meaning: Response crystallization is operationalized as persistence/path-dependence, not as the source symbolic crystallization.

design.replication_note: Use the same hardware/context when possible; later add counterbalanced sequences to separate path-dependence from simple order effects.

conditions.label: Low void · ascending
conditions.experimental_question: Does temporal Void, operationalized as silence ratio with period/predictability/carrier/modulation held constant, alter the predeclared subjective outcome?

held_constant.master_gain_policy: same configured gain across conditions; record actual RMS/Peak dBFS per block

source_construct.definition: Estructura de baja información utilizada para modular expectativa.

provenance.title: Vacío
provenance.notes: La fuente no fija una métrica; esta operacionalización temporal pertenece al piloto.

operationalization.definition: Proportion and arrangement of active-signal time versus deliberately silent time in a deterministic schedule.

entropy_control.rule: Fixed 10-second periodic cycle; no random jitter. Entropy is not manipulated in pilot v0.1.

blinding.reveal_rule: Do not reveal model expectation before the participant saves the required observation probes.

measurement_boundary.engine: AEON records generated browser signal and deterministic stimulus schedule; it does not measure acoustic SPL at the ear.
measurement_boundary.participant: Ratings and free reports are subjective observations, not diagnoses.
measurement_boundary.causality: A change observed after a condition is not labeled as caused by the carrier, wound, or symbolic construct without further controlled replication.

primary: Plot felt_presence against silence_ratio for ascending C1/C2/C3.
Compare repeated 50% condition C2 vs C4.
Compare repeated 20% condition C1 vs C5.
secondary: Repeat plots for space_occupancy, expansion_contraction and expression_impulse without treating them as co-primary outcomes.
Inspect free-text/body-map data only after numeric primary analysis is frozen.
across_sessions: Compare sign of void_response_slope across at least 3 replications.
Do not call a pattern stable if direction reverses repeatedly.
If hysteresis appears, later counterbalance starting direction to test order effects.

stop_rules: Participant may stop or skip any probe at any time.
Do not interpret acute distress or physical symptoms through the symbolic model; use appropriate health support when needed.
non_goals: No claim that 432 Hz treats Invisibilidad Relacional.
No claim that alpha 8 Hz measures or entrains an alpha brain state.
No claim that a high persistence metric proves Retención Afectiva.
No organ/chakra prediction is shown before participant observation.
No wound-specific carrier comparison in Pilot 01.
